family: Explanatory editorial diagram — primary lane of ARTICLE-ILLUSTRATION-ROUTING.md §4.1 (~70% of article-body visual use).
primary_job: Make a relationship, process, or authority boundary easier to inspect than prose (ARTICLE-ILLUSTRATION-ROUTING.md §1 'explain', §2.2).

semantic_density.rationale: One claim or mechanism per image, held to a compact set of groups — richer than a thumbnail's single tension but narrower than a body infographic's multi-module synthesis (ARTICLE-ILLUSTRATION-ROUTING.md §4.1).

visual_density.rationale: Grid-led composition, sparse connectors, clear first-read hierarchy, low decorative density (ARTICLE-ILLUSTRATION-ROUTING.md §4.1).

text_policy.complexity_ceiling: Deterministic short relationship/boundary labels only; mutable copy (titles, dates, captions, citations) stays outside the artwork (ARTICLE-VISUAL-PUBLICATION-HANDOFF.md §1).
text_policy.enforcement: scripts/validate-composition-plan.mjs checks composition.label_strategy.max_labels against this family's ceiling of 6. Ceilings were stated before SUE-628 and nothing checked them: the rejected SUE-570 plate shipped 22 labels against visual/body-infographic's ceiling of 8 (signature F7).

composition.dominant_structure: One relationship, process, or authority boundary, grid-led, with sparse connectors that clarify hierarchy rather than build a dense network (ARTICLE-ILLUSTRATION-ROUTING.md §2.2; DIAGRAMMATIC-VISUAL-LANGUAGE.md §2 line behavior).
composition.reading_path: Single inspection path along the relationship or process.

enclosure_budget.derivation: Typography carries structure through four independent channels — size, weight, case and asymmetric whitespace — for roughly 3-4 distinguishable tiers. Enclosure becomes necessary only where the structure is NOT hierarchical: independent parallel categories with no rank relation, where size and weight have no 'which is bigger' answer to encode. Everything else drawn as a box is a tier typography could have carried (benchmarks/EDITORIAL-INFOGRAPHIC-INFORMATION-DESIGN.md T10, contradiction C2).
enclosure_budget.negative_evidence: The rejected SUE-570 body infographic drew 12 enclosures for 4 load-bearing modules — cards containing chips containing text (signature F2).

position_convention.acceptance_test: Name the axes. If neither dimension of the plate can be given a semantic name, the plate is a list wearing a diagram's clothes.
position_convention.rationale: In the conditionally-acceptable chart lane, coordinates are arithmetic on values, so measuring the picture recovers the data. In the rejected infographic the modules sat at hand-assigned coordinates in a 2x2 arrangement whose axes encoded nothing — borrowing the appearance of a matrix without the encoding. 'topological' exists so that a plate whose position honestly means nothing can say so; the failure is undeclared position, not absent position (T1, contradiction C1, signature F1).

audience_adaptation.domain-expert: Legend optional; technical relationship vocabulary allowed without expansion.
audience_adaptation.beginner-learner: Decompose the relationship into fewer, explicitly labeled steps; expand every acronym on first use.
audience_adaptation.child-upper-elementary: Use concrete, literal depictions of the relationship rather than schematic abstraction; the legend cannot be load-bearing (audience/child-upper-elementary.json modality_effects.visual).

renderer_preference.rule: Topology and relationship arrows that carry a factual boundary must stay deterministic and traceable; generative rendering is reserved for illustrative connective tissue and must never invent topology (ARTICLE-ILLUSTRATION-ROUTING.md §2.2, §12 renderer integrity).
renderer_preference.generative_boundary: Plain 'generative' is not representable for this family — absent from the enum, not merely discouraged. A generative raster model may never own exact numbers, exact labels, citations, factual relation geometry, load-bearing connectors or typography. Under 'hybrid' or 'generative_support' the non-deterministic step contributes bounded non-load-bearing material only, and a load-bearing generative contribution is a routing error rather than a style choice.

requirements: line weight/contrast that survives mobile rendering
no reliance on hover or desktop-only interaction

strategy.note: min_effective_type_px is the rendered size at the stated viewport, not the authored size. Every asset in the SUE-570 set — including the two conditionally-acceptable charts — is a fixed-viewBox SVG whose only response to a narrow viewport is uniform scaling, producing 5.2-8.7px effective type. This defect is systemic rather than infographic-specific (signature F5, trait T9).

readability_gate.rationale: A body-placed explanatory diagram is a body-facing visual and inherits the SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §5 mobile gate.

split_rule.rule: If the diagram begins carrying more than one relationship/process/boundary, split it into separate diagrams rather than compressing labels (generalization of SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §6 to the single-relationship case).

acceptance: the reviewer can state which relationship, process, or boundary the diagram makes inspectable
one dominant relation, not an assembled set of unrelated nodes
passes VISUAL-INFORMATION-GAIN.md — the diagram is not a redraw of an immediately preceding sequence or pairing
carries a composition plan validating against schemas/composition-plan.schema.json
declares what spatial position encodes, and passes the name-the-axes test
declares a mobile strategy from reflow|restack|replate|split with >= 14px effective type at 390px
reject: generic network-node wallpaper with no thesis (DIAGRAMMATIC-VISUAL-LANGUAGE.md §12)
ornamental nodes that add no relation
paragraph-to-icons transcription with one label per noun and no new relation (VISUAL-INFORMATION-GAIN.md §10 R3)
spatial position that encodes no relation while implying that it does (signature F1)
more drawn enclosures than parallel-category boundaries (signature F2)
a module whose only content is a sentence inside a border (signature F3)
uniform downscaling offered as a mobile strategy (signature F5)

composition_plan.rationale: AES-V2.16b / SUE-628. Before this, the path from article to image carried a semantic_spec of three string arrays with no relation model, reading order, geometry, enclosure budget or mobile strategy — which is the gap every SUE-570 failure signature except one escaped through (evals/negative-baselines/SUE-570-INFOGRAPHIC-FORENSICS.md). A plate in this family is planned before it is rendered, and the plan is the versioned artifact.
